Department: Product Development

Location: Canada - Flex (0006)

Description

This is a 12-16 month co-op position starting in May 2027 and can be on-site in our Toronto office, hybrid or entirely remote in Canada.

Join Vena Solutions as a Software Development Co-op Student and grow technically and professionally within a collaborative, high-performance team. Vena is an industry-leading financial and operational planning platform serving thousands of organizations globally, including enterprise brands. As a Microsoft Unicorn partner with $100M+ USD in annual recurring revenue, we're building a cloud-native SaaS platform that brings the familiarity of Excel together with enterprise-grade planning, reporting, forecasting, and AI-powered decision-making capabilities. Working remotely, or in our Toronto office, you'll join an Agile Scrum team where you'll contribute to real product features used by finance and business teams at scale, solve production challenges, and gain hands-on experience in a rapidly growing scale-up.

How You'll Make An Impact



- Develop new features and functionality for our financial planning platform used by modern finance teams at scale
- Collaborate with full-time developers in Agile Scrum teams to design, build, and deploy meaningful product improvements
- Help identify and resolve production issues, contributing to platform stability and reliability
- Take ownership of well-defined areas of our product, building practical experience in full-stack development
- Work with our modern tech stack including TypeScript/React front-end, Java/SpringBoot back-end microservices, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure)
- Gain exposure to real-world integration challenges across the Microsoft ecosystem (Excel, Teams, Power BI, PowerPoint, Azure)
- Leverage AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to move faster and focus on solving complex problems
- Contribute to meaningful company initiatives including Hackathons, Guilds, and cross-functional projects that shape our product vision
- Learn best practices in modern SaaS development while working alongside experienced engineers
- Build a network and mentorship relationships in a culture that encourages innovation and ownership

We'd Love to See



- Currently enrolled in a post-secondary co-op program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Registered with an accredited cooperative education program and available for a co-op internship
- Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for writing clean, maintainable code
- Curiosity about modern development tools and technologies, and eagerness to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment
- A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively within cross-functional Agile teams
- Initiative to take ownership of projects and willingness to contribute to company culture
- A growth mindset and desire to accelerate your learning through hands-on experience on real production systems
- Comfort working in a hybrid environment and adaptability to changing priorities in a scale-up setting
- Interest in AI and willingness to explore AI-driven solutions to enhance performance and drive efficiencies

We appreciate all interest in this opportunity. However, we will only be considering applicants who are currently enrolled in a registered university co-op program in Ontario and available for a 12-or 16-month full-time co-op starting in May 2027.



- Our salaries are tailored to roles, levels and locations. Your individual pay within this range is influenced by factors like work location, skills, experience and education. As you progress in your role, your compensation may adapt, offering flexibility for growth beyond initial levels. For specifics, your recruiter will provide details and address any questions during the hiring process.
fit_why: Full-stack TypeScript/React co-op matches his main stack directly

At Sun Life, we’re driven by our Purpose: helping our  Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.   

 Our student and new graduate programs offer a chance to explore Sun Life from the inside. You’ll make a difference in the lives of our customers and communities, while building the skills and experience that allow you to grow in a meaningful and rewarding way.

 Job Description: 
 Job description: 
 The Associate Software Engineer Student will join the Contact Centre Innovation & Operations (CCIO) team, helping design and deliver innovative solutions that improve the employee and client experience. Working alongside engineers, product owners, AI specialists, and operations teams, the student will contribute to initiatives involving Generative AI, virtual agents, intelligent automation, cloud platforms, contact centre technologies, and digital employee experience solutions.

 Preferred skills: 
 
• Curious mindset and passion for technology, innovation, and continuous learning. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
• Ability to quickly learn new technologies and tools. 
• Comfortable working in a collaborative Agile team environment. 
• Self-motivated with the ability to take ownership of assigned work. 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
 Qualifications: 
 
• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. 
• Experience with one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript. 
• Exposure to cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform is an asset. 
• Knowledge of REST APIs is an asset. 
• Exposure to Generative AI technologies, large language models, prompt engineering, or AI development tools is considered a strong asset. 
• Familiarity with Agile and DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Git, or automation tools is an asset. 
 Responsibilities: 
 
• Collaborate with Agile delivery team members to build, test, and support innovative digital solutions. 
• Contribute to the development of AI-powered applications, virtual assistants, and intelligent automation capabilities. 
• Support the integration of cloud-based services and enterprise platforms using modern engineering practices. 
• Develop and maintain high-quality, secure, well-documented code and automation solutions. 
• Participate in proof-of-concept development, experimentation, and innovation initiatives. 
• Analyze business processes and identify opportunities to improve employee experience, operational efficiency, and service delivery through automation & AI. 
• Assist with testing, troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous improvement activities. 
• Contribute to engineering best practices including DevOps, automation, AI governance, and software quality. 
• Present findings, prototypes, and recommendations to team members and stakeholders. 
 The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted for. The Base Pay which you will be considered for will vary depending on the Campus program you are selected for.

 Eligible Sun Life employees for various Campus Graduate programs will also participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance

 Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

 Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com .

 We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

 We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

 We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 Job Category: 
Temporary Employee 
 Posting End Date: 
14/10/2026
fit_why: Python/JS/TypeScript, REST APIs, AI/LLM exposure, CI/CD all match

jd:
Join us and assimilate cutting edge tech knowledge at SOTI: Next Gen! 

 Job Title:  Software Developer (Intern)
 Position Type: Co-op  
 Location:  Mississauga, ON (Hybrid)
 Temporary, Internship 

 Opportunity  

 As an intern at SOTI you will be involved in the design/development/support of new or existing software applications. These applications range from cloud-based solutions, mobile apps for Android or iOS, middle tier server software or backend database components.
 
Our fundamental goal at SOTI is to give you an opportunity to learn. Where possible we will try and direct you to a project that aligns with your interests and skills.
 
The technologies you learn during an internship at SOTI range from developing front end logic using technologies such as Angular and JavaScript, learning to develop middle tier services using languages like C#, or deepening your knowledge of databases by leveraging SQL and learning how to build high performance apps using storage procedures. Depending on the area you work in, you may get an opportunity to learn about technologies such as data analytics, machine learning, fault tolerant computing, building high end scalable solutions, or vision systems.
 
Fun: While we work hard at SOTI, we also play hard. We have a variety of sports nights including ball hockey, soccer, basketball, badminton, table tennis, and many more. You can also choose to participate in various special events such as games night, poker night, and other activities. We also have our annual events such as our SOTI day company picnic and games day at a park, as well as our annual Christmas party.
 
 What you will learn: 
 
• Enhance your programming skills by working in a team alongside experienced team members 
• Gain an understanding of how various roles work together to deliver software products: Developers, Architects, Quality Assurance, User Experience, Product Management, Software Development, Marketing, etc. 
• Gain an understanding of how user requirements are gathered, and the various processes used to translate real-world problems into software solutions 
• Understand the tools and processes used to develop professional software products e.g. Jira, Git 
• Understand the testing processes and frameworks used to deliver high quality software products 
 Required skills:   
 
• Knowledge of algorithms, data structures and database fundamentals 
• Basic knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle concepts 
• Strong math, analytic and problem-solving skills 
• Basic knowledge of programming in one or more of the following programming languages: C, C++, Java, JavaScript, SQL, Ruby, Rust, Lua, Haskell 
• Most importantly curiosity, a desire to learn and be a part of a team 
 About SOTI 

 It all started with a classic story about one developer’s vision. While Carl Rodrigues, President and CEO of SOTI, was an IT consultant, he developed solutions for managing mobile device screens from a desktop. An innovation that has put him ahead in what is now one of the largest growing markets – Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM).
With a passion for innovation, and a relentless drive for quality, Carl now leads one of the fastest growing, profitable, and self-sustaining companies in Canada, and continues to build on the company’s early lead in the enterprise mobility market.
 
 Today, more than 17,000 enterprise customers around the world depend on us to secure, manage, and support their mobile operations, with millions of devices managed worldwide. SOTI’s two decades of success has built strong partnerships with leading mobile platform providers and device manufacturers. At SOTI, we have demonstrated commitment to staying at the forefront of mobility management and security. We are deeply committed to researching and developing solutions that address today’s toughest mobility challenges. We strive to go where nobody has gone before.

 #LI-KI1
 SOTI is home to many faiths, cultures, and nationalities. The SOTI family is an example of an inclusive work culture that is respectful to all. We are always looking for fresh and innovative thinkers who can make a difference. We offer careers with #EndlessPossibilities.   

 What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!  

 If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today. 
 
 Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring 
 
 SOTI uses AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing resumes, screening qualifications, and creating interview questions. These tools assist our team only-final hiring decisions are made by people, not automation. For privacy-related questions, please contact privacy@soti.net . 
 
 We are committed to providing accessible employment practices that are in compliance with the requirements under the Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please notify People & Culture at careers@soti.net . growth. Engage! 
 
 Please note that SOTI does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Services Agreement with agency/recruiter, SOTI will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee.
